sum: Shirpur Gold Refinery Limited continues corporate insolvency proceedings with 30th Committee of Creditors meeting held 29 June 2026 (rescheduled from 25 June). The meeting was conducted via video conference, signalling ongoing resolution or liquidation assessment under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code.
detail: Shirpur Gold Refinery Limited, a listed company, is in Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under IBC 2016. The 30th Committee of Creditors meeting, originally scheduled for 25 June 2026 at 4:00 PM, was deferred and subsequently held on 29 June 2026 from 11:00 AM to 11:55 AM via Zoom. The disclosure was made pursuant to SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations 2015, Regulation 30 and Schedule III, indicating continued compliance obligations during insolvency. The advanced CoC meeting count (30th) reflects either multiple rounds of deliberation on competing resolution plans, extensions granted by NCLT, or evaluation of a revised/alternative resolution proposal.
